verses.sloka: इति उक्ता राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसास्ते महाबलाः ।ऊचुः प्रान्जलयः सर्वे रावणम् राक्षस ईश्वरम् ॥६-७-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: iti uktā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasāste mahābalāḥ ।ūcuḥ prānjalayaḥ sarve rāvaṇam rākṣasa īśvaram ॥6-7-1॥।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas of mighty strength, having heard the Lord of Rakshasas, thus spoke to their leader, greeting with folded hands.
translations.hindi: जल पी ~ हे सतमः संग; [क त्युक्ता रात्चसेन्द्रेण राचसास्ते महाबलाः । ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्‌

verses.sloka: द्विष्त्पक्ष्ह्मविज्ञाय नीतिबाह्यास्त्वबुद्धयः ।राजन् परिघ शक्ति ऋष्टि शूल पट्टस सम्कुलम् ॥६-७-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: dviṣtpakṣhmavijñāya nītibāhyāstvabuddhayaḥ ।rājan parigha śakti ṛṣṭi śūla paṭṭasa samkulam ॥6-7-2॥।।

translations.english: "O King The ogres are not having political intelligence. They have submitted themselves, even though they are mighty and are having iron bars, javelins, sharp edged spears, and doubleedged swords."
translations.hindi: महाराज; जब तक शत्रु का बलाबल न मालूस हो, तब तक परामर्श देना नीति-विरुद्ध और निवुद्धियों का काम दै

verses.sloka: सुमहन् नो बलम् कस्माद् विषादम् भजते भवान् ।त्वया भोगवतीम् गत्वा निर्जताः पन्नगा युधि ॥६-७-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sumahan no balam kasmād viṣādam bhajate bhavān ।tvayā bhogavatīm gatvā nirjatāḥ pannagā yudhi ॥6-7-3॥।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas having spoken like that, to the Rakshasas, who were very strong, but ignorant about the enemy's strength and who were not endowed with political wisdom, spoke to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, the following words with folded hands.
translations.hindi: जाला १ अस्मिन्न-“लक्ानिरोधनरूपे कार्ये । (गो०) हे राजन्‌ ! हम लोगों के पास परिघ, शक्ति, यष्टि, शूल और पटाधारिणी एक महती सेना है । अतः आप विषाद क्यों करते हें

verses.sloka: कैलास शिखर आवासी यक्षैर् बहुभिर् आवृतः ।सुमहत् कदनम् कृत्वा वश्यस् ते धनदः कृतः ॥६-७-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: kailāsa śikhara āvāsī yakṣair bahubhir āvṛtaḥ ।sumahat kadanam kṛtvā vaśyas te dhanadaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥6-7-4॥।।

translations.english: "Oh king, (our army is equipped with) iron bars, javelins, double edged swords, spears, three pointed weapons, ploughs etc."

verses.sloka: स महाईश्वर सख्येन श्लाघमानस् त्वया विभो ।निर्जितः समरे रोषाल् लोक पालो महाबलः ॥६-७-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa mahāīśvara sakhyena ślāghamānas tvayā vibho ।nirjitaḥ samare roṣāl loka pālo mahābalaḥ ॥6-7-5॥।।

translations.english: "Why are you despondent? You have huge and mighty army strength. When you went to Bhogavathi, the Nagas were subdued in war by your mighty army."
translations.hindi: कुवेर से घोर युद्ध कर, उसे अपने वश में किआ है। महादेव का मित्र कहकर, जो कुवेर स्त्रयं अपनी बड़ाई किआ करते हैं

verses.sloka: विनिहत्य च यक्षौघान् विक्षोभ्य च विगृह्य च ।त्वया कैलास शिखराद् विमानम् इदम् आहृतम् ॥६-७-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: vinihatya ca yakṣaughān vikṣobhya ca vigṛhya ca ।tvayā kailāsa śikharād vimānam idam āhṛtam ॥6-7-6॥।।

translations.english: He who dwells on the peak of Mount Kailasa, surrounded by numerous yakshas, was, after great affliction was visited upon him, made to submit to you.

verses.sloka: मयेन दानव इन्द्रेण त्वद् भयात् सख्यम् इच्चता ।दुहिता तव भार्या अर्थे दत्ता राक्षस पुम्गव ॥६-७-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: mayena dānava indreṇa tvad bhayāt sakhyam iccatā ।duhitā tava bhāryā arthe dattā rākṣasa pumgava ॥6-7-7॥।।

translations.english: "O King Proud of his friendship with Lord Maheshwara (Siva), that mighty ruler of the world Kubera was subdued by you in the conflict."
translations.hindi: तुम कैलासपवत से यह पुष्पक विमान ले आए । मय नामक दैत्यराज ने भयभीत हो तुमसे मैत्री करने के लिए

verses.sloka: दानव इन्द्रो मधुर् नाम वीर्य उत्सिक्तो दुरासदः ।विगृह्य वशम् आनीतः कुम्भीनस्याः सुख आवहः ॥६-७-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: dānava indro madhur nāma vīrya utsikto durāsadaḥ ।vigṛhya vaśam ānītaḥ kumbhīnasyāḥ sukha āvahaḥ ॥6-7-8॥।।

translations.english: "Causing terrific disturbance to the hordes of Yakshas and taking them as prisoners, you have brought the great aerial chariot from mount Kailas."

verses.sloka: निर्जितास् ते महाबाहो नागा गत्वा रसा तलम् ।वासुकिस् तक्षकः शन्खो जटी च वशम् आहृताः ॥६-७-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: nirjitās te mahābāho nāgā gatvā rasā talam ।vāsukis takṣakaḥ śankho jaṭī ca vaśam āhṛtāḥ ॥6-7-9॥।।

translations.english: "Maya, the ruler of Danavas has given his daughter (Mandodari) to you as a wife out of fear of you, O leader of Rakshasas"

verses.sloka: अक्षया बलवन्तः च शूरा लब्ध वराः पुनः ।त्वया सम्वत्सरम् युद्ध्वा समरे दानवा विभो ॥६-७-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: akṣayā balavantaḥ ca śūrā labdha varāḥ punaḥ ।tvayā samvatsaram yuddhvā samare dānavā vibho ॥6-7-10॥।।

translations.english: "Madhu, another ruler of Danavas who was proud of his valour and difficult to approach, the husband of Kumbhinasi was subjugated by you by your offering to fight with him."
translations.hindi: वहाँ के वासुकी, तक्षक, शङ्ख और जटी, इन प्रधान नागों को अपने बश में कर लिश्रा। कभी न मरने बाले, बलवान, शूर और पूव में बर पाए हुए

verses.sloka: स्व बलम् समुपाश्रित्य नीता वशम् अरिम् दम ।मायाः च अधिगतास् तत्र बहवो राक्षस अधिप ॥६-७-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: sva balam samupāśritya nītā vaśam arim dama ।māyāḥ ca adhigatās tatra bahavo rākṣasa adhipa ॥6-7-11॥।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed king Going to the subterranean world, you won over the serpent demons Vasuki, Takshaka, Shanka and Jati and made them submit to you."

verses.sloka: शूराः च बलवन्तः च वरुणस्य सुता रणे ।निर्जितास् ते महाबाग चतुर् विध बल अनुगाः ॥६-७-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: śūrāḥ ca balavantaḥ ca varuṇasya sutā raṇe ।nirjitās te mahābāga catur vidha bala anugāḥ ॥6-7-12॥।।

translations.english: "The mighty and strong Danava warriors who had obtained boon were made to fight a war by you for one year."
translations.hindi: हे राक्षसराज ! बहुत माया जानने वाले महाबली लोकपालों को तुमने युद्ध में जीता

verses.sloka: मृत्यु दण्ड महाग्राहम् शाल्मलि द्वीप मण्डितम् ।कालपाशमहाईचिम् यमकिम्करपन्नगम् ॥६-७-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: mṛtyu daṇḍa mahāgrāham śālmali dvīpa maṇḍitam ।kālapāśamahāīcim yamakimkarapannagam ॥6-7-13॥।।

translations.english: "O king of Rakshasas (Those Danavas) were reduced to sub mission by resorting to your own strength. Oh subduer of enemies, many deceitful tricks were learned from them."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे फिर स्वग तक में जा इन्द्र का परास्त ।क्रा । फर युद्ध म वरुण के उन पुत्रों को जो बड़े शूर बलवान थे

verses.sloka: महाज्वरेण दुर्धर्षम् यमलोकमहार्णवम् ।अवगाह्य त्वया राजन् यमस्य बल सागरम् ॥६-७-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: mahājvareṇa durdharṣam yamalokamahārṇavam ।avagāhya tvayā rājan yamasya bala sāgaram ॥6-7-14॥।।

translations.english: "O blessed king Mighty strong sons of Varuna, heroes capable of war and of all the four kinds of army have been won by you."
translations.hindi: और चतुरंगिणी सेना से युक्त थे, तुमने जीता। हे राजन्‌ ! तुमने मृत्यदण्डरूप महानक्रों से युक्त, यातनारूपी शाल्मलीद्रुम- मंडित, काज्ञपाशरूपी महातरङ्ग से लहराते, यम के किङ्कररूपी सपो के कारण भयङ्कर ऑर महाज्वर से दुधष, यमलोक रूपी महासागर में डबकी मार तुमने बड़ी भारी विजय प्राप्त की और तुमने मौत. को भी रोक दिया । वहाँ पर घोर युद्ध कर तुमने सब लोकां को भली भाँति सन्तुष्ट कर दिया

verses.sloka: जयः च विप्लुलः प्राप्तो मृत्युः च प्रतिषेधितः ।सुयुद्धेन च ते सर्वे लोकास् तत्र सुतोषिताः ॥६-७-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: jayaḥ ca viplulaḥ prāpto mṛtyuḥ ca pratiṣedhitaḥ ।suyuddhena ca te sarve lokās tatra sutoṣitāḥ ॥6-7-15॥।।

translations.english: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.

verses.sloka: क्षत्रियैर् बहुभिर् वीरैः शक्र तुल्य पराक्रमैः ।आसीद् वसुमती पूर्णा महद्भिर् इव पादपैः ॥६-७-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṣatriyair bahubhir vīraiḥ śakra tulya parākramaiḥ ।āsīd vasumatī pūrṇā mahadbhir iva pādapaiḥ ॥6-7-16॥।।

translations.english: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.

verses.sloka: तेषाम् वीर्य गुण उत्साहैर् न समो राघवो रणे ।प्रसह्य ते त्वया राजन् हताः परम दुर्जयाः ॥६-७-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: teṣām vīrya guṇa utsāhair na samo rāghavo raṇe ।prasahya te tvayā rājan hatāḥ parama durjayāḥ ॥6-7-17॥।।

translations.english: "Oh King Plunging into the ocean, which was in the shape of Yama's realm, with an enormous alligator in the form of rod of death, adorned with Salmali trees, turbulent with a huge wave in the form of Death 's noose, infested with Lord of Death's attendants as serpents, unassailable on account of the mighty Jwara (spirit of fever), you have obtained a great victory over the Lord of Death 's great army and the army was warded off. By your good battle all the people (of the world) were delighted.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र के समान पराक्रमी बहुत से वीर चत्रियों से यह प्रथिवी, बड़े-बड़े वृत्तों की तरह पूण थी

verses.sloka: तिष्ठ वा किम् महाराज श्रमेण तव वानरान् ।अयमेको महारज इन्द्रजित् क्षपयिष्यति ॥६-७-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha vā kim mahārāja śrameṇa tava vānarān ।ayameko mahāraja indrajit kṣapayiṣyati ॥6-7-18॥।।

translations.english: "The earth was fully filled with Kshatriya heroes of great prowess, equal to Indra in war who stood like trees on earth."
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे--“वि [5 उनके पराक्रम, बल, उत्साह और गुण ऐसे थे कि, रामचन्द्र रण में उनका सामना कभी नहीं कर सकते; परन्तु हे राजन्‌ ! तुमने उन परम दुर्जेप्र ज्षत्रियों को भो मार डाला

verses.sloka: अनेन हि महाराज महेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ।इष्ट्वा यज्ञम् वरो लब्धो लोके परमदुर्लभः ॥६-७-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: anena hi mahārāja maheśvaramanuttamam ।iṣṭvā yajñam varo labdho loke paramadurlabhaḥ ॥6-7-19॥।।

translations.english: "Raghava is not equal to them in valour, excellence and energy. Those warriors who were difficult to overcome by battle were overpowered and killed by you."

verses.sloka: शक्तितोमरमीनम् च विनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलम् ।गजकच्चपसम्बाधम्श्वमण्डूकसम्कुलम् ॥६-७-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: śaktitomaramīnam ca vinikīrṇāntraśaivalam ।gajakaccapasambādhamśvamaṇḍūkasamkulam ॥6-7-20॥।।

translations.english: "Oh great king, you stay here calmly. Why exert yourself? This strong armed Indrajith alone can destroy those Vanaras."

verses.sloka: रुद्रादित्यमहाग्राहम् मरुद्वसुमहोरगम् ।रथश्वगजतोयौघम् पदातिपुलिनम् महत् ॥६-७-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: rudrādityamahāgrāham marudvasumahoragam ।rathaśvagajatoyaugham padātipulinam mahat ॥6-7-21॥।।

translations.english: "Oh Great King By performing supreme sacrifices, Indrajith obtained boons from Lord Maheswara, which are very difficult to get."
translations.hindi: यद्धरूपौ महासागर मैं शक्तिरूपी मत्स्य, बिखरी हुई आंतड़ी. रूपी सिवार, हाथीरूपी कछवे, घोड़ेरूपी मेंढक, रुद्र आदित्य रूपी बड़े-बड़े घड़ियाल, मरुतवसु रूपी बड़े-बडे सोप, रथ अश्व- गज रूपी जल और पैदल सैनिक रूपी बड़े बड़े टापू थे

verses.sloka: अनेन हि समासाद्य देवानाम् बलसागम् ।गृहीतो दैवतपतिर्लङ्काम् चापि प्रवेशितः ॥६-७-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: anena hi samāsādya devānām balasāgam ।gṛhīto daivatapatirlaṅkām cāpi praveśitaḥ ॥6-7-22॥।।

translations.english: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

verses.sloka: पीतामहनियोगाच्च मुक्तः शम्बरवृत्रहा ।गतस्त्रिविष्टपम् राजन् सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ॥६-७-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: pītāmahaniyogācca muktaḥ śambaravṛtrahā ।gatastriviṣṭapam rājan sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ॥6-7-23॥।।

translations.english: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.
translations.hindi: यह दैवताओं के सैन्यरूपी महासागर में घुसकर ओर देवराज को पकड़कर, उन्हें लङ्का के बंदीगह में डाल चुका है

verses.sloka: तमेव त्वम् महाराज विसृजेन्द्रजितम् सुतम् ।यावद्वानरसेनाम् ताम् परामाम् नयति क्ष्हयम् ॥६-७-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tameva tvam mahārāja visṛjendrajitam sutam ।yāvadvānarasenām tām parāmām nayati kṣhayam ॥6-7-24॥।।

translations.english: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.
translations.hindi: यय पितामहनियोगाञ्च मुक्त; शम्बखुत्रहा । A 0. ० Ce है > गतास्रावष्टप राजन्‌ संवदवनसस्ळुतः

verses.sloka: राजन् न आपद् अयुक्ता इयम् आगता प्राकृताज् जनात् ।हृदि न एव त्वया कार्या त्वम् वधिष्यसि राघवम् ॥६-७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: rājan na āpad ayuktā iyam āgatā prākṛtāj janāt ।hṛdi na eva tvayā kāryā tvam vadhiṣyasi rāghavam ॥6-7-25॥

translations.english: "Liberated by the command of creator Brahma, Indra the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra entered heaven was adorned and greeted by all Devas."
translations.hindi: अन्त में पितामह ब्रह्मा जी के कहने से शचरासुर ओर वृत्र सुर का मारने वाला सर्वेदेवनमस्कृत इन्द्र छोड्‌ दिला गया ० > था और तब वह स्वर्ग की राजधानी में गया था ॥. २४ ॥ तमेव त्वं महाराज विसजेन्द्रजितं सुतस्‌ । यावद्वानरसेनां तां सरामां नयति ज्ञयम्‌
